blocks.content: Key functions of constitutional authorities ensure the balance of power and effective governance.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Executive functions focus on administrative implementation, policy execution, and maintaining public order.
Legislative functions encompass law-making, national budget approval, and executive accountability.
Judicial functions center on constitutional interpretation, protection of fundamental rights, and dispute resolution.
Regulatory bodies perform specialized supervisory functions to ensure market equilibrium and fair governance.
Distinguish between constitutional, statutory, and non-statutory executive functional bodies.
Focus heavily on quasi-judicial powers vested in institutions like the CAG, UPSC, and Election Commission.
Memorize key functional constitutional articles (e.g., Article 280 for Finance Commission, Article 324 for Election Commission).
